decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the necessary cards and mana to generate a large storm count, allowing for a powerful combo finish with Tendrils of Agony. The deck utilizes various fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal, along with cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond to build up the storm count rapidly. Other cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy help to disrupt the opponent's strategy while protecting the combo. The goal is to efficiently chain together spells and maximize the storm count to finish the game with a devastating Tendrils of Agony.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck utilizes tools like Brainstorm and Ponder to manipulate the top of the deck for maximum efficiency. Wasteland and Lightning Bolt provide additional disruption while Murktide Regent serves as a powerful finisher. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game with a mix of efficient creatures and versatile instant and sorcery spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells to apply pressure on the opponent while also controlling the game through countermagic and removal. By combining aggressive threats like Grief, Troll of Khazad-dûm, and Uro with disruption like Force of Will, Stifle, and Brainstorm, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also presenting a clock to close out the game quickly. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate to provide additional value and resilience.

The deck focuses on assembling the Dark Depths combo, using cards like Thespian's Stage and Crop Rotation to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token quickly. It also utilizes tools like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to search for key lands and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Wasteland and Swords to Plowshares. The deck aims to control the board while setting up its combo finish, with elements of graveyard recursion and card advantage to provide flexibility and resilience in different matchups.

This deck features an aggressive strategy that focuses on disrupting the opponent's plans while deploying threats quickly. It utilizes powerful hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Stoneforge Mystic to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Mother of Runes provide protection for key creatures. The deck also makes use of Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game in a quick and efficient manner. The main strategy is to efficiently set up the Doomsday pile, using cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Personal Tutor to find the necessary combo pieces while controlling the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Stifle, as well as mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual. The goal is to win the game before the opponent can disrupt the combo.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing efficient creatures and powerful spells to control the board and pressure opponents quickly. By using cards like Stalactite Stalker, Delver of Secrets, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure and out-tempo opponents. Additionally, the deck includes a variety of disruptive spells like Stifle, Daze, and Force of Will to disrupt opponents' game plans. With a mix of card advantage engines and efficient removal spells, the deck aims to maintain board presence and control the game until securing victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play for a devastating combo finish. It uses cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal for fast mana acceleration, alongside disruptive spells like Unmask and Thoughtseize to protect its combo pieces. The deck aims to control the game early on with disruptive creatures like Grief, and then overwhelm the opponent with its powerful reanimation strategy.

The main concept of this Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through targeted discard spells like Thoughtseize and Pest Control, as well as counter spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells such as Prismatic Ending and Swords to Plowshares. Additionally, the deck utilizes card filtering and card advantage engines like Brainstorm and Ponder to sculpt the perfect hand. The win condition of the deck is to resolve powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Triumph of Saint Katherine to close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly control the board and apply pressure on the opponent through a combination of aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, backed up by efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan using counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, while also generating card advantage through cantrips like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Mishra's Bauble. The deck utilizes a mix of tempo and card advantage to outpace the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a large number of spells and interactive elements to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, and board wipes like Terminus. The deck also includes powerful cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath for value and card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and synergy with the deck's strategy. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through careful resource management and strategic plays.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly discard powerful creatures into the graveyard and then reanimate them onto the battlefield. The deck utilizes cards like Dark Ritual, Entomb, Faithless Looting, and Reanimate to quickly put creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Griselbrand, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play. The deck also includes disruption elements like Grief, Thoughtseize, and Unmask to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining a fast and efficient reanimation strategy with disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently set up the combo using Doomsday to stack your deck in a way that allows you to win the game on the following turn. This is achieved by using cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate mana, as well as counter spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect your combo pieces. Thassa's Oracle is used as the win condition, ensuring that you win the game if you have set up your deck correctly. The deck focuses on fast and precise plays to outmaneuver opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 games.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then using spells like Entomb and Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. With efficient card draw and counterspells to protect the combo, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game. The deck utilizes a mix of disruptive creatures like Grief and efficient reanimation spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while advancing its own towards a quick victory.

The primary goal of this deck is to control the game through countering and disrupting your opponent's plays while utilizing powerful creatures like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath to close out the game quickly. Stifling key abilities and using cards like Dress Down and Swords to Plowshares to handle threats gives you the advantage in tempo and card advantage. The deck also aims to consistently hit land drops using fetch lands and Wasteland to disrupt your opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on using lands to control the game, utilizing cards like Exploration, Valakut Exploration, and Crop Rotation to generate advantage. It aims to disrupt opponents with Wasteland and Sphere of Resistance while creating a strong board presence with cards like Thespian's Stage and Dark Depths. The deck also has tools for removal and lifegain, such as Punishing Fire and Ghost Quarter. With the ability to tutor for specific lands with cards like Urza's Saga and Life from the Loam, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a slow and methodical manner.
